title: How Deckbuilding Works in Vauren Beastborn! 🃏✨
author: VaurensBeastBorn
selftext:
🚨 Vauren: Beastborn is ON STEAM! Adding it to your Wishlist helps our 2-dev team immensely!   
  
How Deckbuilding Works in Vauren: Beastborn! 🃏✨  
  
Here is a full tour of our custom deckbuilder interface and card mechanics:  
  
🛠️ Management: Create new decks, edit existing ones, or share builds with the community!  
  
🧙‍♂️ Heralds & Echoes: Pick your Herald, name your deck, choose your Echo, and pick the best passive combo for your strategy.  
  
⚡ 4 Skill Cards: Equip 1 Ultimate, 1 Echo Summon, and 2 Basic Skills (zero cooldown between turns!).  
  
📌 30-Card Decks: Set 5 GUARANTEED starting cards for your opening hand—once played, you start drawing randomly from the rest of your deck!  
  
💬 What do you think of our deckbuilding mechanics? Let us know your thoughts in the comments below! 👇
